Free Event control with one initially present Auxilia executes free.

findings.title: Motivation inflicts a Counterattack Loss after every German defender has been removed
source: Reference Documents/Chapter 3:144-146 (§3.2.4 Step 4, surviving Defending Forces cause Counterattack Losses)
Reference Documents/Ariovistus/A Card Reference:138-144 (A33 shaded Motivation +1 Counterattack Loss)
findings.expected: After eight Belgic Warbands inflict two halved Losses on the only two German Warbands, no German Forces survive to Counterattack; all eight Belgae survive. Motivation still adds one Loss when a German defender survives.
findings.observed: Accepted ordinary Battle kills both Germans but also one Belgic Warband. Counterattack resolver still runs on the empty defending force and Motivation adds one Loss to zero.
controls: Without Motivation, the same empty defending force removes no Belgae (8 survive).
With Motivation and three Germans initially, one German survives Attack and correctly inflicts the extra Loss (7 Belgae survive).
findings.newness: Neither prior 50/21/15 inventories cover nonexistent German Counterattack. Prior A33 lifecycle/Retreat restrictions and EX3-04 Stalwart/Horse are different consumers and clauses.
findings.fixture: build_initial_state(Ariovistus, seed=1), all factions human, 20 Belgic Resources, 8 Belgic and 2 German Warbands at Carnutes, A33 shaded activated. All piece placements use helpers. Permanent Roman Fort explicitly placed in Provincia per §1.4.2; fixture corrected and all final witnesses rerun, outcomes unchanged.
findings.witness: probe_commands.py::motivation; durable validate_response + execute_decision; clean validate_state/check_structural_integrity before and after
findings.repair_direction: Gate the Counterattack bonus/resolution on the required surviving defending force, preserving applicable structure-only edge cases according to the source; add wiped-force and surviving-force regressions.

findings.title: Non-player Retreat decisions use pre-Attack strength and require an unnecessary escape destination
source: Reference Documents/Chapter 8:207-219 (§8.4.3 save last Defending piece, guarantee half the Losses, Gauls leave all Hidden Warbands when Retreating from Romans)
Reference Documents/Chapter 3:144-146 (§3.2.4 surviving Defending Forces Counterattack)
Reference Documents/Chapter 3:150-159 (§3.2.4 Retreat survivor movement and Hidden Warband/Leader exception)
findings.expected: 8 Belgic Warbands attacking 6 NP Aedui with a safe Aedui-controlled Veneti destination require Aedui Retreat: a stand loses four Warbands and two survivors can inflict only one Loss, below half of four. Retreat leaves four Aedui surviving in Veneti (five including resident), all eight Belgae survive. Separately, 2 Hidden NP Aedui attacked by 4 Roman Auxilia must Retreat to save the last piece even without a legal destination, because the one surviving Hidden Warband stays in Carnutes.
findings.observed: First case stands, leaves 2 Aedui in Carnutes and inflicts only 1 Loss on Belgae. Second case stands and loses both Hidden Aedui; adding otherwise irrelevant safe Veneti control causes legal Retreat and leaves one Hidden survivor in Carnutes.
controls: 4 NP Aedui with safe destination correctly Retreat under save-last-piece rule.
8 NP Aedui with safe destination stand and guarantee exactly half, inflicting 2 after suffering 4.
The Hidden-survivor case with a safe destination correctly Retreats but does not actually move its surviving Hidden Warband.
findings.newness: Earlier BATTLE-RETREAT-CHOICES addressed human declarations/dispositions; prior Roman Legion forecast corrections concerned §8.4.3 second bullet. This finding concerns NPC third-bullet pre-casualty forecast and first-bullet destination veto.
findings.grouping: Two errors in the same NPC Retreat decision function are one repair group rather than separate findings.
findings.fixture: Census/structurally valid controlled positions built with piece helpers. Great Revolt seed=1, only Aedui marked non-player. Carnutes/Veneti adjacent and safe destination controlled through one Aedui Warband. No saving-roll or choice uncertainty in the primary guarantee witness. Permanent Roman Fort explicitly placed in Provincia per §1.4.2; fixture corrected and all final witnesses rerun, outcomes unchanged.
findings.witness: probe_commands.py::np_retreat and ::np_hidden_retreat; ordinary durable validation and live execution, with detached declaration diagnostic; all census/structure checks clean
findings.repair_direction: Evaluate surviving guaranteed Counterattack strength and actual Retreat removals/stay exceptions. Apply each §8.4.3 condition independently, with deterministic detached forecasts and live survivor controls.

findings.title: Ariovistus Harvest can drive Roman Resources below zero
findings.expected: Roman Resources must remain within 0–45 even when the Ariovistus Roman victory formula is negative. This finding requires a nonnegative result and does not decide whether negative earnings may reduce a positive balance.
findings.observed: A valid board with 26 non-Roman Allies and 6 Settlements has Roman victory -2 and no faction passing victory. Public harvest_phase changes starting Roman Resources0 to-2 and1 to-1. Public run_winter_round with no relocations also ends at-2 and a structural error. Removing all Settlements produces score4, Resources4, clean structure.
findings.mechanism: _harvest_earnings passes the negative score to _add_resources, which clamps only the upper bound.

findings.title: Roman March target ranking omits Germanic Settlements from total Allied strength
findings.expected: In Ariovistus, all Settlements count as Allies for Roman Battle/March conditions and priorities. With a tier-four die roll, Germans with one Ally plus two Settlements outrank Aedui with two Allies.
findings.observed: A census/structure-valid seed-5 initialized position reaches Roman March through the complete public bot dispatcher. It chooses Carnutes/Aedui and moves all four Roman Legions there. German total_ac is one although it should be three. Replacing the two Settlements by two physical Allies makes the same dispatcher choose Germans. With only the one German Ally, the Aedui choice is correct.
findings.root_cause: Roman destination collection includes Settlements in local_ac but calls a generic Ally-disc-plus-Citadel helper for total_ac. Tier four sorts by that incomplete total before local priorities.
findings.newness: Not in original 50 or second/third comparison ledgers. Unlike WS3-01 Harvest or XC3-01 Colony consumers, this is a scenario-specific Settlement-as-Ally rule in Roman bot strategic targeting. Local Settlement recognition already works.
findings.fixture: Controlled initialized Ariovistus board using canonical piece helpers, valid physical inventory and Tribe structures before and after. No claim of naturally sampled reach. Final accepted fixtures include the permanent Roman Fort in Provincia per Chapter 1:122–124.
findings.scope_limits: Dynamically confirmed for tier-four Roman March. The same generic helper is used by Roman Battle ranking, but that additional path is static corroboration only. Do not globally add Settlements for every consumer without each consumer source rule.
findings.comparator_pattern: lod-bot coin-implementation-lessons.md E (flowchart fidelity), B (producer/consumer data shape), I (plausible code omits precise rule adjustment).

findings.title: Diviciacus safety gate turns a guaranteed safe Aedui Battle into Pass
findings.expected: A lone Diviciacus in Carnutes with a Belgic Ally and ten Aedui Resources must Battle after declining/no access to Event. The Leader inflicts one Loss and the Ally has zero Counterattack. Diviciacus cannot take a Loss.
findings.observed: node_a4 recognizes the guaranteed high-value Loss, but dispatch_bot_turn returns Pass. Executing the ordinary source-required Battle through execute_decision removes the Belgic Ally and leaves Diviciacus alive, with clean census/structure. Adding one Aedui Warband makes the complete bot dispatcher select Battle.
findings.root_cause: Both Battle-selection loops reject losses_suffered >= expendable_aedui, so zero >= zero declares a threat to an unharmed Leader. The gate also uses a coarse pre-Attack estimate; only the zero-loss equality boundary is dynamically claimed here.
findings.newness: Not in prior 50/21/15 ledgers. Separate from current commands agent Retreat forecast group: this is active Aedui bot Battle selection with Diviciacus, no Retreat or uncertain rolls and no enemy troops.
findings.fixture: Controlled initialized Ariovistus board using canonical piece helpers and named Tribe allegiance, valid census and structure before/after the legal Battle. Final accepted fixtures include the permanent Roman Fort in Provincia per Chapter 1:122–124.
findings.scope_limits: Dynamically confirmed for zero counterattack Losses/zero supporting troops. Other equality and unrelated-enemy safety cases remain uncounted.
findings.comparator_pattern: lod-bot coin-implementation-lessons.md E (flowchart violations and silent bot degradation), F (cross-faction effects), I (precise boundary misreading).
